description:
Hua Tuo, the highest-ranking Chinese doctor of the late Han Dynasty, is possessed by a modern-day surgical intern!

“It’s so vain.” Hua-bu, who was known as a divine doctor, dies in prison from a curse that wasn’t a curse of Cao Cao…

 *“Is he still alive?”*

When he opens his eyes in excruciating pain, what he sees are… unfamiliar objects and letters he’s never seen before! 

*“W-what’s going on? Am I, am I possessed by the body of a doctor from another world?”*

Memories of the body’s owner, Lee Min-Ho, flood into Hua Tuo’s mind. No matter how different the world is, how on earth does a world like this exist…! 

*“Who summoned me into the body of this young man?”*

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
